description: Sampling frame for the RRA (owner-editable).  Schools are a sampling frame only; gap specs must be jurisdiction-neutral.

US.name: Harvard Business School
US.notes: required core: Finance 1, Financial Reporting and Control, Leadership and Organizational Behavior, Marketing, Technology and Operations Management, FIELD

US.name: Stanford Graduate School of Business
US.notes: approx. 30 AI courses offered; required core varies. Management Practices (GSB 591, Bloom and Van Reenen) lecture materials: https://worldmanagementsurvey.org/teaching/teaching-materials/stanford-gsb-mba/

US.name: MIT Sloan School of Management
US.notes: Finance Theory I (15.401, Prof. Andrew Lo) syllabus: https://www.ocw.mit.edu/courses/15-401-finance-theory-i-fall-2008/pages/syllabus/ ; Finance Theory I full materials (lectures, problem sets, exams with solutions): https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/15-401-finance-theory-i-fall-2008/resources ; Finance Theory II (15.402) materials: https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/15-402-finance-theory-ii-spring-2003/resources ; Corporate Finance (15.434, Paul Asquith): https://web.mit.edu/15.434/syllabus.html ; Sloan list of finance course syllabi: https://alo.mit.edu/teaching/ Undergraduate: Principles of Microeconomics (14.01, Jonathan Gruber, Fall 2018): https://ocw.mit.edu/14-01F18 ; 14.01SC self-study (Fall 2011) syllabus/exams/recitations: https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/14-01sc-principles-of-microeconomics-fall-2011/pages/syllabus/syllabus/ ; 14.01 (Fall 2023) lecture notes, videos, problem sets, exams with solutions: https://live.ocw.mit.edu/courses/14-01-principles-of-microeconomics-fall-2023/lists/exams ; Sloan undergraduate subject list (e.g. 15.0111 Economic Analysis for Business Decisions): https://catalog.mit.edu/subjects/15

US.name: The Wharton School
US.notes: AI for Business MBA major (2025); required Applied ML in Business and accountable-AI ethics course. MBA Inside course listing (2019): https://mba-inside.wharton.upenn.edu/tentative-courses-20a/ ; older syllabi reported on 'Syllabi@Wharton' (working link not confirmed).

US.name: Chicago Booth
US.notes: Managerial Decision Making (BUS 38802, George Wu, Summer 2015), syllabus and resources: https://faculty.chicagobooth.edu/george.wu/teaching/private/38802/resources.htm ; Faculty teaching pages (e.g. https://faculty.chicagobooth.edu/chad-syverson/teaching) sometimes link to syllabi; official Course Search reported to host syllabi for upcoming quarters (not opened to confirm).

US.name: Yale School of Management
US.notes: Undergraduate: Financial Markets (ECON 252, Robert Shiller, 2011) free recorded course with syllabus/lectures/transcripts (behavioral finance, banking, options markets, investment banks, regulation): https://oyc.yale.edu/node/963 ; self-paced Coursera version: https://www.coursera.org/learn/financial-markets-global/paidmedia

UK.name: London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE)
UK.notes: BSc Management: Finance (FM101), Elements of Financial/Management Accounting (AC102/AC103), economics, quantitative methods, LSE100; later options Principles of Finance (FM210/211), Financial Statement Analysis and Valuation (AC332), Corporate Finance, Investments and Financial Markets (FM310/311). Management programme regulations: https://www.lse.ac.uk/resources/calendar2025-2026/programmeRegulations/undergraduate/2025/BScManagement.htm ; Accounting and Finance (2024/25): https://lse.ac.uk/resources/calendar2024-2025/programmeRegulations/undergraduate/2024/BScAccountingAndFinance.htm ; individual course guides (detailed syllabi) linked from LSE course pages.

UK.name: University of London (LSE-designed distance degrees)
UK.notes: BSc Management and Digital Innovation syllabus-level courses (Principles of Accounting, Introduction to Finance, Principles of Corporate Finance): https://london.ac.uk/courses/management-and-digital-innovation

UK.name: University of Oxford
UK.notes: BA Economics and Management: first year compulsory Introductory Economics, General Management, Financial Management; Prelims then finals; degree outline: https://sbs.ox.ac.uk/programmes/degrees/bahons-economics-and-management/degree-outline ; 2026 entry course information sheet: https://assets-oxweb.admin.ox.ac.uk/2026-02/Economics%20and%20Management%20CIS%202026-entry.pdf ; student handbook: https://www.economics.ox.ac.uk/sitefiles/prog-0592-ba-in-economics-and-management-student-handbook-25-access-1.pdf

UK.name: University of Warwick
UK.notes: BSc Economics and Management: year 1 all compulsory; year 2 core EC204, EC226, IB249, IB2B1 plus WBS options; final year EC347 + options. Full regulations: https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/soc/economics/current/ug/handbook/bsc_economics_and_management_l1n2_regulations-updated_14-10-2025.pdf ; module hub: https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/soc/economics/current/ug/modules
